name: Adachi Taeko
source:
Taeko lives in in Aomori (青森), Aomori, and goes to Aogaki High School (青垣高校). She's a third year student in class A.

She likes children, and playing with the neighborhood kids. She's good at skiing, and shoveling snow. She helps out her mother at the family store.
